# Two-dimensional Arrays

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Two-dimensional Arrays

The array we have learned so far is a single-dimensional array.

![Single dimensional array](data:image/png;base64,)

In Java, we can also create two-dimensional arrays (2D arrays).

![Two-dimensional array](data:image/png;base64,)

A two-dimensional array is an array of arrays. This means each element of a 2D array is an array itself (as shown in the above image).

By taking the reference from the above image, let's see how we can create a 2D array in Java.
